summary: A model gives text that usually looks like what you asked for. You get a JSON Schema from your Pydantic model, put it in the prompt, cut the JSON out of whatever comes back, validate it, retry with the exact problem, and fail loudly. Everything is tested with a scripted model, so no key is needed.
goal: Ask a model for JSON in a fixed shape, validate it with Pydantic, and retry with the exact problem.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: print the schema, run try_structured.py and match the five scenarios
Step 2: set max_attempts to 1, predict which scenarios change, then check
Step 3: give a chatty reply and a fenced reply straight to Pydantic and read the error
Step 4: write TicketSummary, test a too-long title then a correct reply, and read the tool-use demo
Play the Schema Judge game to the end and see your score
